title: Counting Accrued Days of Lateness on a Home-Site Lease Billing Period
content:
Accrued days of lateness on a Home-Site Lease billing period start from the day after the last grace day of that period. Where they end depends on the latest payment and on the nonpayment notices on the lease, the first matching row governing:

| Records on the lease | Days accrue through |
|---|---|
| the latest payment was received after the last grace day | the day before that payment |
| no payment came after the last grace day, and the most recent nonpayment notice was served on or after the due date | the date of that notice |
| neither of the above | the posting date |

The latest payment is the single most recent payment received on the lease. Both the first and the last day of the run are counted.

**Desk illustrations (hypothetical; rent due on the 1st, last grace day the 6th, so days accrue from the 7th)**

| Records | Run | Accrued days |
|---|---|---|
| latest payment received on the 10th | the 7th through the 9th | 3 |
| no payment after the 6th; nonpayment notice served on the 12th; posting on the 20th | the 7th through the 12th | 6 |
| no payment after the 6th; no nonpayment notice since the due date; posting on the 15th | the 7th through the 15th | 9 |
| latest payment received on the 10th, and a nonpayment notice served on the 12th | the 7th through the 9th (the payment row comes first) | 3 |

A nonpayment notice served before the due date of the period does not end the run.
